stories.title: Weekend story sessions for young children begin at Abakhan bookshop in Mostyn
stories.summary: A children’s bookshop at Abakhan in Mostyn has started weekend storytelling sessions for young children and their families. Curious Little Imagineers is running the sessions, called Cosy Cabin Tales, every Saturday and Sunday at 10.15am. Each one lasts between 20 and 30 minutes. stories.title: Flintshire council proposes double yellow lines on A5026 Fron Park Road in Holywell
stories.summary: Double yellow lines are planned at five junctions in Holywell, four of them on the A5026 Fron Park Road, under proposals published by Flintshire County Council on Friday. stories.title: Airbus Broughton: 110-aircraft Avolon order covers both A320 and A330 wing programmes
stories.summary: Airbus has taken a firm order for 110 aircraft from leasing company Avolon, covering two aircraft families whose wings are made at Broughton. stories.title: North Wales fire callouts reach 13-year high as false alarms make up nearly half
stories.summary: The fire service attended 6,644 incidents across North Wales last year, its highest total in 13 years, and nearly half were false alarms, new figures show.
